parts.part: A month always in view, not in a picker
parts.tried: 400x800 and 1280x800, light and dark: the month is on the page at load. Tab reaches Previous month, Next month, the grid (one stop, on the focused day), Today. Enter/Space on the arrows, arrows/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown in the grid (October 2026 to January 2027 and back), Enter on Today from January 2027. Heading, grid label and the live announcement follow; focus stays on the control pressed; focused days are in view with a ring at both widths.
failures: At load, and whenever today (16) is the start or end of what is chosen, today's number is invisible: computed text rgb(81,96,118) on a circle of rgb(81,96,118) in light, rgb(183,200,225) on rgb(183,200,225) in dark. A blank filled circle is drawn where 16 should be (other selected ends draw white on the fill). Seen at both widths, both themes, by keyboard and by mouse.
unsure: the dot under a day that holds appointments is visual only (aria-hidden); a day's name ('Tuesday, November 17, 2026') does not say it has appointments.

parts.tried: In the grid: Enter on 18, ArrowRight to 22, Enter: cells 18-22 aria-selected, focused cell named 'Selected Range: Wednesday, November 18 to Sunday, November 22, 2026', heading 'Nov 18 – Nov 22', '5 days chosen', list goes 'Loading…' then '9 appointments' headed day by day. Also a range across months (Space, PageDown, Space: Nov 29 – Dec 30), backwards (Enter, ArrowUp, Enter), Escape mid-way (the earlier range is kept), one day (Enter, ArrowLeft, Enter). Same at 400 wide. Mouse: click then click (Dec 3-9) and a drag (Dec 10-13) both choose the range.
failures: When today is the first or last day of the range its number is invisible (same fault as part 1): e.g. Enter on 16, Enter on 17 draws a blank circle for 16 beside a white 17.

unsure: Enter on a day moves focus to the next day (React Aria's keyboard behaviour), so Enter, Enter chooses two days ('Dec 23 – Dec 24', '2 days chosen'), never one. One day by keyboard needs Enter, ArrowLeft, Enter; the hint on the page ('Press a day, then another for a range.') does not say so.
could_not_exercise: Touch drag (no touch device emulated); the mouse drag stood in for it.

parts.tried: In the dialog, Tab to Start and End: three stops each (hour, minute, AM/PM), each a spinbutton named 'hour, Start' etc. with aria-valuetext. Typed 2, 55, p (focus advances by itself: 2:55 PM), ArrowUp/Down on each segment, PageUp, Home, End, ArrowLeft/Right between segments, Backspace. End before Start then Add: 'After the start' under End in the error colour, the three segments aria-invalid and described by it, focus on End's hour. All segments cleared (incl. Backspace on AM/PM) then Add: 'Enter a start time', focus on Start's hour. Choosing a Visit moves End (Physiotherapy: 9:20 to 10:05). Same at 400 wide, both fields side by side and whole.
failures: A half-cleared time is saved as the old time, with no error: Backspace on Start's hour shows '––:20 AM' (hidden value still 09:20:00, the field's description says 'Selected Time: 12:20 AM'), Tab to Add, Enter: the dialog saves and the list gains '9:20 AM, Ada Lovelace'. It should refuse with 'Enter a start time', or not show an empty hour. The same with hour and minute both cleared ('––:–– AM' still holds the old value until AM/PM is cleared too).
unsure: Enter in a time segment does nothing (it does not submit the form, where Enter in Patient does).

parts.tried: Enter on 'New appointment' (and on the empty day's 'Add appointment'): dialog named 'New appointment', focus in Patient, the page behind hidden, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside (15 stops, all in view at 400 and 1280), Escape and Cancel close and give focus back to the opener. Enter in empty Patient: 'Enter the patient's name', aria-invalid, focus kept. Both selects by Enter/Space/ArrowDown, arrows, End, Enter, Escape (closes the list only). Day by typing 11202026 and by 'Open calendar' (arrows, Enter, OK; Escape returns to its button). Notes takes Enter as a new line. Add by Enter in Patient and by Enter/Space on Add: buttons lock for 600 ms, Escape is ignored meanwhile, dialog closes, snackbar 'Added: …', the row is in the list in time order, focus back on 'New appointment'. Enter on a row: dialog 'Appointment' prefilled, focus on the dialog; changed times, Save: row re-sorted, focus on the saved row. Delete: row gone, 'Deleted: … Undo', focus on a neighbouring row; Undo reached by Tab or F6 and Enter restores the row. Saved onto Dec 3: snackbar 'Saved: … Show', Enter on Show moves the month and the list to Thursday, December 3. Light and dark at both widths; no sideways scroll.
failures: Focus lost to <body> when the row that opened the dialog is no longer listed: Enter on the only row of Nov 16, Tab to Delete, Enter: the list becomes the empty state and document.activeElement is BODY. Should land on something (the heading, 'Add appointment').
Same when an edit moves the appointment to a day not shown: change Day to 12/03/2026, Save: activeElement is BODY.
Same when adding from the empty state: Enter on 'Add appointment', type a name, Enter: the empty state is replaced by the list and activeElement is BODY (should be the new row or 'New appointment').
Enter on the snackbar's 'Show' (and on 'Undo' after the only row was deleted): the snackbar closes and activeElement is BODY, at both widths.

At 400x800 the snackbar covers what is focused after the dialog closes: after Save the focused row sat at y 720-792 and after Delete at y 703-775, under the snackbar at y 736-784; after deleting the only row the empty state's 'Add appointment' button (y 755-795) is under it too, for as long as the snackbar stays (8 s for Deleted).
unsure: while saving or deleting, the pressed button gets aria-disabled and a spinner icon; I found no aria-busy, progressbar role or status text announcing it.
unsure: the dialog changes width with its content (319 px to 341 px at 1280 when Visit becomes Physiotherapy; 448 px in edit mode), so fields shift under the user.

parts.part: A list of the day's events
parts.tried: Tab into the list (one stop; role grid named 'Appointments', rows named e.g. '9:00 AM, Priya Raman, Follow-up'), ArrowDown/Up, Home, End through 13 rows in five day groups (each rowgroup labelled by its day): the page scrolls to keep the focused row in view, ring drawn. Enter on a row opens its dialog and Escape returns focus to that row; a mouse click opens it too. Choosing days shows a skeleton with role=status 'Loading appointments' and 'Loading…' in an aria-live line for 700 ms, then the count. A day with nothing (Sat Nov 21): 'No appointments', 'Nothing is booked on this day.', an 'Add appointment' button reached by Tab that opens the dialog on that day. Same at 400 wide.
failures: At 400 wide the second line of most rows is cut before the visit's length: 'Dr. Amara Okafor · 20 min' is drawn as 'Dr. Amara Okafor ·…' (15 truncated lines in a 13-row list, two patient names among them: 'Hannah Schmidt', 'Samuel Adeyemi'). The length is not in the row's accessible name either; it is only found by opening the dialog and reading Start and End.
